rationale: Shirley brings hands-on ML research and developer-tool experience from CMU and the Chinese Academy of Sciences, while Jake is actively building in AI infrastructure and B2A systems—a space where low-level tooling expertise directly unlocks value. Their complementary skills (Shirley's Python/TypeScript background and PM experience at Zoom + Jake's founder perspective on infrastructure) make them natural sparring partners for exploring how AI productivity tools could integrate with emerging autonomous agent workflows.
intro_message: Shirley Li, meet Jake Fitzgerald — you're both thinking about the infrastructure and tooling layer for AI systems, and could spark ideas on how researcher-backed developer tools fit into the B2A wave Jake is tracking.
